messages:
zoe: quick alert — canary promotion for 3.14.0 hit a batch of quarantined manifests in eu-ecr, looks like signature metadata drift between replica regions.
miguel: which job id?
ci-bot: publish-batch-900 started by @zoe at 2024-12-02T11:12:02Z
deploybot: publish-batch-900: 9/28 pushed, 19/28 quarantined. Error: MANIFEST_METADATA_MISMATCH (409). Conflicting annotations: signing_key and signing_time.
irene: log excerpt: ```
PUT /v2/redwood/router/manifests/sha256:ef12... 409 Conflict
existing annotations: signing_key=kms-eu-08 signing_time=2024-12-02T10:58:01Z
incoming annotations: signing_key=kms-eu-09 signing_time=2024-12-02T11:12:01Z
```
zoe: ops did a key rotation at 10:55UTC, but some mirrors still have objects signed by kms-eu-08.
miguel: immediate impact? any failed pulls?
zoe: no external failures yet. EU canary pods have a split set; risk is runtime/console version mismatch.
irene: recommended short plan: 1) pause release window, 2) pin prod tag to previous digest, 3) request mirror backfill resigns OR run resign+push.
miguel: prefer pin then mirror backfill to avoid creating new digests.
deploybot: autopause condition matched: manifest-metadata-mismatch -> pause release.
ci-bot: publish-batch-900 logs archived: s3://releases/logs/publish-batch-900/
zoe: generating digest list now and opening a ticket.
ire ne: also add a deploybot guard to avoid partial multi-arch pushes in future: require signer-consistency check before attach.
miguel: agree. @zoe please pin and update RR ticket with rollback criteria (canary error-rate > 0.75% or schema mismatch).
zoe: running pinback: 
```
./release-tools pinback --release=3.14.0 --digest=sha256:stable321 --scope=prod --reason="paused: eu signature metadata drift"
```
ci-bot: pinback completed, prod pinned to sha256:stable321
ops-bot: mirror resign progress: 7/28 repos reconciled, catch-up estimated 50 minutes.
irene: ok we'll wait for ops. Do we want a short customer-facing note if window exceeds 1h?
miguel: yes — draft if >60m. Also add an action item: pre-publish check to verify KMS signer id uniformity across mirrors.
deploybot: watch rule created: resume-only-if = quarantines==0 AND signer_state==uniform-kms-eu-09
zoe: thanks all. I'll follow up in RR-490 and write a short postmortem after resolution. :thumbsup:
